kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يكتأب (form VIII)
# يُكْتَأَبُ (yuktaʔabu) /juk.ta.ʔa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
# يُكْتَأَبَ (yuktaʔaba) /juk.ta.ʔa.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
# يُكْتَأَبْ (yuktaʔab) /juk.ta.ʔab/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
